editorial.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create a new high-end editorial product still-life photograph for a minimalist ecommerce brand manifesto. PORTRAIT 4:5 composition, at least 1200px tall. Input reference 1 is a sand aluminium folding desk lamp with a slender light bar and circular base. Input 2 is an olive and warm grey pebble-shaped woven speaker with a braided loop. Input 3 is a cognac grained leather zippered tech organizer pouch with taupe compartments. Faithfully preserve these THREE new product designs; show exactly these products, no additional merchandise. Arrange them beautifully in a refined sunlit modern interior: warm pale limestone desk and sculptural travertine backdrop, softly curving wall, gentle natural shadows from an unseen window. Tall folding lamp to the left/back with whole light bar and base visible, compact speaker at front right, partly open cognac pouch lower front left. Every product fully inside image with generous margins so it works at both portrait and landscape crops; arrange in central 70 percent. Realistic grounded products and contact shadows, meticulous material texture, warm ivory, sand, olive and cognac palette, calm aesthetic and real magazine photography. Leave top 15 percent calm for a tiny website label added separately. No text, no logos, no floating products, no clothes, no watches, no earbuds, no sunglasses, no watermark.
